items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.author: Poyraz Avsever
items.description: Poyraz Soft Glass typography component.

.poyraz-text-outline.transition: color var(--poyraz-motion-duration-base) var(--poyraz-motion-ease-out), text-shadow var(--poyraz-motion-duration-base) var(--poyraz-motion-ease-out)

.poyraz-text-gradient.background-image: linear-gradient(110deg, var(--poyraz-text-effect), color-mix(in srgb, var(--poyraz-text-effect) 48%, white), var(--poyraz-primary-hover))

.poyraz-text-glow.text-shadow: 0 0 0.35em color-mix(in srgb, var(--poyraz-text-effect) 42%, transparent), 0 0 0.8em color-mix(in srgb, var(--poyraz-text-effect) 24%, transparent)
